description: This file contains an Angular component called TreeComponent which renders a hierarchical tree view. It manages node rendering, expand/collapse behavior, selection, highlighting, and interactions within a tree structure for a viewer application.

classes.name: TreeComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying and interacting with a hierarchical tree structure, supporting expand/collapse, highlighting, and node actions.

methods.name: childTrackById
methods.description: Determines the unique identifier for tracking child nodes, based on stable ID or property key.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, setting default collapsed state.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input changes, specifically updating selection if the item is highlighted.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Removes event listeners from the node element when component is destroyed.

methods.name: onNodeClick
methods.description: Handles click events on nodes, toggling expand/collapse or updating highlight.

methods.name: nodeOffsetStyle
methods.description: Computes CSS styles for indentation based on hierarchy level.

methods.name: updateHighlightedItems
methods.description: Emits event to update highlighted item ID.

methods.name: isPinned
methods.description: Checks if the current node is pinned based on pinned items list.

methods.name: propagateNewHighlightedItem
methods.description: Emits event to propagate new highlighted item ID.

methods.name: propagateNewPinnedItem
methods.description: Emits event to propagate new pinned item.

methods.name: propagateNewSelectedTree
methods.description: Emits event to propagate new selected tree node.

methods.name: isClickable
methods.description: Determines if node is clickable.

methods.name: toggleTree
methods.description: Toggles collapsed state of the node.

methods.name: expandTree
methods.description: Expands the node.

methods.name: isCollapsed
methods.description: Checks if node is collapsed, considering global or local state.

methods.name: children
methods.description: Returns the child nodes of the current item.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Determines whether the current node has children displayed.

methods.name: setCollapseValue
methods.description: Sets the collapsed state, updating store if global state is used.

methods.name: nodeMouseDownEventListener
methods.description: Handles mousedown events to prevent double actions.

methods.name: nodeMouseEnterEventListener
methods.description: Handles mouse enter events for hover state.

methods.name: nodeMouseLeaveEventListener
methods.description: Handles mouse leave events for hover state.
